title: Using Analytics to Enable Utilities to Act Proactively During Extreme Weather
content: Electric distribution utilities operate in a changing and more volatile environment. Extreme weather has become more frequent, severe, and more costly, requiring utilities to invest in infrastructure to maintain safety and reliability under increasingly severe conditions.
author:
Eric Zhuang, 
Debbie Dhaliwal
